external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague of a franchise store who is vouched for by the franchise store's identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.

external_entities.name: identity provider
external_entities.description: The identity provider used by franchise colleagues to sign in.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system that supplies group membership changes and leaver information overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.

external_entities.name: franchise store
external_entities.description: A franchise store whose colleagues are admitted through their own identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, signs tokens, maintains directory membership, and writes sign-ins to an audit log.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
processes.notes: The text does not state the broker's interface type or exposure.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses the token's groups to authorize price changes and transaction voids for every store.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.
processes.notes: The text does not state the console's interface type or exposure.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker to sign tokens for every application.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
data_stores.notes: The text does not state whether the key store is encrypted where it sits.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory containing colleagues and the groups they are in.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_stores.notes: The text does not state whether the directory is encrypted where it sits.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route. Nobody has written down whether the log is encrypted where it sits.

data_flows.name: colleague sign-in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in through the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

data_flows.name: franchise colleague sign-in
data_flows.description: A franchise colleague is signed in through the broker based on a vouch from the franchise identity provider.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state which franchise colleagues the identity provider is allowed to vouch for.

data_flows.name: identity provider vouch
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague to the broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
data_flows.notes: The text does not state which colleagues that provider is allowed to vouch for.
data_flows.data_description: Vouch for a franchise colleague's sign-in

data_flows.name: token issuance
data_flows.description: The broker issues a signed token carrying a colleague's staff id and group list for use by the application.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.data_description: Token containing staff id and group membership

data_flows.name: public key fetch
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the broker's signing key to check token signatures.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: Public half of the token-signing key

data_flows.name: signing key read
data_flows.description: The broker reads the signing key it uses to sign tokens from the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: directory maintenance
data_flows.description: The broker maintains its directory of colleagues and group membership using HR changes.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_flows.name: membership change pull
data_flows.description: The broker pulls group membership and leaver changes from the HR system once a night.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night
data_flows.data_description: Overnight group membership and leaver changes

data_flows.name: sign-in log
data_flows.description: The broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network on which the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: franchise store
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise-side zone containing franchise colleagues and their identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

trust_boundaries.name: HR system
trust_boundaries.description: The zone containing the HR system that supplies overnight changes.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: it comes from the HR system overnight.

assumptions.assumption: The key store's contents are confidential because it holds the token-signing key.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the key store holds a signing key.

assumptions.assumption: The directory's contents are confidential because it holds colleagues, staff identities, and group membership.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the directory keeps colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The audit log's contents are confidential because sign-in records can identify colleagues and their authentication activity.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.
